A classed refusal from the small-sample power gate

Source: R/abstention.R
survkit_refusal.Rd

Construct the typed "will not fit" token survkit() returns when on_underpowered = "abstain" and the events-per-variable gate (survkit_power()) flags the model as under-powered. Not signalled as a condition – returned as an ordinary value, so a caller inspects it with is_survkit_refusal() rather than a tryCatch().

Usage

survkit_refusal(power)

Arguments

power

A power-gate result from survkit_power(), already flagged underpowered.

Value

A classed list with class c("survkit_refusal", "orchestra_refusal", "error", "condition") and elements reason, n, n_events, n_predictors, events_per_variable, min_epv, underpowered (always TRUE), message.

See also

survkit(), survkit_power(), is_survkit_refusal().

Other model-fitting: is_survkit_refusal(), survkit(), survkit_cuminc(), survkit_power(), survkit_rmst(), survkit_score(), survkit_triangulate()

Examples

df <- data.frame(time = rexp(20), status = rbinom(20, 1, 0.2),
                 x1 = rnorm(20), x2 = rnorm(20))
p <- survkit_power(survival::Surv(time, status) ~ x1 + x2, df)
r <- survkit_refusal(p)
is_survkit_refusal(r)
#> [1] TRUE
